fusions.name: Thorny Switch
fusions.desc: Lashes with a thorned branch for 4 damage, making the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Rooted Stomp
fusions.desc: Stamps the ground so roots grip every enemy within 3 tiles: it deals 10 damage, strips 10% of their armour and 20% of their movement speed for 5 seconds, and has a 50% chance to leave each [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Your afflictions on each spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Nesting Bower
fusions.desc: Bends branches into a leafy nest where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Leaf-Fed Bulk
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 8%. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
